## Agency Overview: TechSonance InfoTech LLP
TechSonance InfoTech LLP is an enterprise software engineering and AI automation studio co-founded by Sajesh Adeya. The agency specializes in:
1. **Multi-Tenant SaaS Development**: Custom multi-tenant platforms with isolated schema architecture, role-based access control (RBAC), and proxy-friendly onboarding.
2. **Enterprise Web & Mobile Applications**: High-throughput web applications using Next.js 16, React 19, Node.js, and React Native / Expo.
3. **Logistics & Fleet Systems**: Specialized transport management tools, lorry receipt (LR) generators, e-Way bill lookups, and corridor profit analytics.
4. **Point of Sale (POS) Solutions**: Offline-first hybrid desktop/web POS systems built with Electron, SQLite, and cloud PostgreSQL synchronization.
5. **AI Workflow Automation**: Integration of Groq Llama 3.3, Google Gemini, OCR receipt parsing, and natural language WhatsApp billing bots.
6. **Cloud & Microservices Modernization**: Monolith to microservices decomposition, legacy CORBA to modern Spring Boot/Node.js migrations, zero-downtime AWS deployments.

## Detailed SaaS Case Studies & Product Index

### 1. TechSonance Marketplace
- **Canonical URL**: https://marketplace.techsonance.co.in/
- **Category**: Multi-Tenant E-Commerce SaaS Platform
- **Core Value Proposition**: Allows sellers and retail vendors to launch 100% branded online stores in under 10 minutes with custom domains, isolated database tenancy, 0% platform transaction fees, Razorpay payment routing, and Shiprocket shipping automation.
- **Key Features**:
  - Drag & Drop Storefront Page Builder
  - Custom Domain Support with SSL Auto-Provisioning
  - Multi-Warehouse Inventory & Variant Tracking
  - Razorpay Payout Routing & Automatic Tax Invoicing
  - Shiprocket Logistics Automation, Label Printing & NDR Exception Handling
  - Native Growth Tools: Coupons, Flash Sales, Product Bundles, Referral Rewards, Cart Recovery
- **Architecture**: Next.js 16, React 19, Node.js, PostgreSQL with RLS, Tailwind CSS.

### 2. AccuNest
- **Canonical URL**: https://accunest.techsonance.co.in/
- **Category**: Enterprise Accounting, GST Compliance & Inventory Suite
- **Core Value Proposition**: Generates legal GST tax invoices in under 30 seconds for Indian shopkeepers, wholesalers, and manufacturers. Integrates WhatsApp billing chatbots and AI OCR bill scanners.
- **Key Features**:
  - CGST, SGST & IGST Auto-Splitting & HSN/SAC Directory Lookups
  - FIFO Stock Valuation & Real-time Inventory Alerts
  - Bank Statement Reconciliation (ICICI, HDFC, SBI) & Razorpay Link Bindings
  - Groq Llama 3.3 Voice/Text WhatsApp Billing Bot
  - Tesseract AI OCR Scanner for Vendor PDF/Receipt Parsing
- **Architecture**: Next.js 16, React 19, Express REST API, MongoDB, Groq AI, Gemini AI.

### 3. FreightFlow
- **Canonical URL**: https://freightflow.techsonance.co.in/
- **Category**: Fleet Operations & Highway Logistics OS
- **Core Value Proposition**: Replaces paper Lorry Receipts (LRs) and spreadsheets for transport operators, automating e-Way bill validation, GTA Reverse Charge tax calculations, and trip-level P&L tracking.
- **Key Features**:
  - Digital Lorry Receipt (LR) Creation in <30 seconds with WhatsApp Sharing
  - Trip Expense Ledgers tracking Driver Advances, Fuel Slips, Tolls & Wages
  - One-Click NIC e-Way Bill Lookup & e-Invoice IRN Generation
  - Automated Fleet Expiry Alerts (PUC, Fitness, Insurance)
  - PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) Multi-Tenant Scoping
- **Architecture**: Next.js, React 19, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, Docker.

### 4. SyncServe POS
- **Canonical URL**: https://syncserve.techsonance.co.in/
- **Category**: Offline-First Retail & Restaurant Point of Sale
- **Core Value Proposition**: Guarantees zero-downtime checkout speeds (<1.2s per transaction) by processing orders locally via SQLite during internet outages and background-syncing to cloud PostgreSQL/MongoDB servers.
- **Key Features**:
  - Local SQLite Checkout Engine inside Native Electron Wrapper
  - Kitchen Order Ticket (KOT) Generation & Addon Modifier Groups
  - Visual Floor & Table Management with Occupancy Indicators
  - Bi-directional Prisma Sync Engine with Data Conflict Resolution
- **Architecture**: Next.js 16, React 19, Electron, Prisma ORM, SQLite, PostgreSQL.

### 5. Masterweg
- **Canonical URL**: https://masterweg.com/
- **Category**: Higher Education Admission & Bavarian Grade Portal
- **Core Value Proposition**: Assists international students applying for Master's degrees in German public universities through automated grade conversions, course matching, and budget calculators.
- **Architecture**: Next.js, React 19, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, GSAP.

### 6. Utsav (UtsavManager)
- **Canonical URL**: https://utsav.techsonance.co.in/
- **Category**: Cultural Trust & Event Administration SaaS
- **Core Value Proposition**: Coordinates temple trusts, street mandals, high-volume digital donation pipelines (₹4.8Cr+ processed), and live GPS procession tracking maps.
- **Architecture**: Next.js, React Native, Expo, Supabase, PostgreSQL.
